name: sample-facet

protocol.note: vg-sample-facet samples a real MTLTexture through a real MTLSamplerState via a hand-written compute-encoder readback kernel (vg_sample_facet); it is compared byte-for-byte (within float tolerance) against software-linear-sampler, a pure-CPU nearest/bilinear oracle (reference::sample_facet) that reads the same backing allocation bytes directly out of core::Arena. A second run_sample_facet() call against the same CanonicalView (same allocation id/generation, unchanged representation_epoch) must report facet_cache_hit=true, proving the MTLTexture was reused rather than recreated and re-uploaded.

correctness.tolerance: nearest: exact texel match within 1/255 + 1e-4; bilinear: 1/255 + 1e-3 (float blend across GPU vs. CPU rounding)

judgement: vg-sample-facet demonstrates a real Metal MTLTexture/MTLSamplerState pair created from a CanonicalView, sampled nearest and bilinear through a compute-encoder readback kernel, and matching the CPU software-linear-sampler oracle within float tolerance for both filter modes and RGBA8Unorm. Warm cache reuse is demonstrated directly: a second call with an unchanged CanonicalView (same allocation generation and representation_epoch) reuses the cached MTLTexture with no new MTLDevice texture-creation call, reported via SampleFacetResult::facet_cache_hit. Scope boundary (explicit, not a gap): this milestone covers 2D textures, RGBA8Unorm/R32Float, nearest/bilinear filtering, and clamp/repeat wrap modes only, sampled through the existing compute command encoder -- it does not implement a render pipeline, AttachmentFacet, StorageFacet, array/mip textures beyond the CanonicalView field's existence, cube maps, or compressed formats; those are out of scope for E008 and are not silently assumed complete.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024); sample_facet_vulkan_source() exists as a GLSL combined-image-sampler analogue but is deliberately not wired into vulkan_device_hal.cpp in this milestone (no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
